content: An'lɔɔŋ a Ywan Un'düümà

content.text: Mbul wàkwem aŋityeen wà imfum a Mfum Tibɛr Sɛzar, umpal kàkäl Pɔnsɔ Pilatu kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r u Yuday, Ɛlɔdi u Ngalilɛ, un'tɔŋ ande Filipo u Itürɛ anà u Trakɔnit, Lizanyas u Abilɛn,
anà umpal a andwer a angaŋ Anà anà Kayifa, ndaa a Nzam yàyi akà Ywan mwan a Zakàlye, u nsye a ipɔl.
Nde kàyilyaaŋà u nsi yanswà yà tsütsü a ngyäl a Yɔrdan muyilɔŋ baar mubuul mpem anà mukadümà ntɔn badwääl nkul a man'be aba
asànaa bàsön ya uboo a un'kaan a ndaa a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay naa: « Yi ndaa a mbuur akasaa in'kwɛŋ u nsye a ipɔl:
"Làlɔ̈ɔ̈n mbwo a Mwol, làsuub myäy ande.
Un'baan wanswà akyer ayàyɔl, mɔŋ wanswà anà iköl kyanswà ikyer ayàtye, mbwo aŋàkwàkwarà ikyer ayàsubà, mbwo aŋàkwà bàkyer ayàlɔn."
Mbuur wanswà ayàman mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàpɛ Nzam. »

content: In'sɛŋ a baar myàyee akà Ywan ntɔn nde kadümà. Nde kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: « Mbil a iyäy, nà kàlaswɛŋ mutiin nkyɛl iyà ungö?
Làswɛŋ u nsyääl abɛ naa bɛ lan'buul mpem, wɛɛ twon lan'tɛn u mpem abɛ naa: "Abàlam wà nkaa abi." Ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa Nzam kan'kwo utwey ikyee a Abàlam unsà nkɔŋ yi.
Làler, fà itaan nkwar ya tsütsü mutsul in'te kà in'swɛy a mya: un'te wanswà mpa afàbɔr mbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ bàkyer ayun'tsul, waa bàyun'tɔɔm u mbaa. »
Baar bun'fuulà naa: « Apɛy bi waa ikyer aben? »
Nde waa kàfuur naa: « Wɛy mbuur awe abyà inkur byeel upɛ imwɛy akà mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n a kya, wɛɛ mbuur awe anà isaa adyà ukyer sye abà. »
Afüür a itɛr sye bàyi ntɔn badümà, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyer aben? »
Nde waa kafuur naa: « Twon lan'kwɛy undiir udu a indiir bàlaswɛŋ mukyer. »
Aŋità sye bàfuul naa: « Atöl bi ikyer aben? » Nde waa kafuur naa: « Twon lan'gyɔɔr undiir a mbuur, twon lan'yib, làkyey làfur abɛ mpɛl. »
Baar bàkäl anà ngyal muyöb naa nkye Ywan wà Klistɔ bàdilà ba.

Nde kàtɛn a baar banswà naa: « Mɛ, mɛ in'kàladümà kà an'dà, wɛɛ mbuur ayàyà ungö amɛ kàman'söön u ngwal, mɛ in'kwe anki musɔɔl in'siŋ a sàbar ande. Nde bɛ ayàladümà u Dweelà In'kyɛɛl anà u mbaa.
Nde we anà impye ande u kɔɔ ntɔn mukaab mbɛŋ anà un'lɛŋ. Nde mbɛŋ ayàsà uboo a ikɔr ande, wɛɛ nde un'lɛŋ ayàtɔɔm u mbaa mpa ifàdim. »
Abun Ywan kàswɛŋà ndaa asin mbɔɔn akà un'sɛŋ mukyer anà kun'kyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Apan sye Ywan kàtɛɛnà a Ɛlodi, mbuur kàfayaalà u Ngalilɛ, ntɔn kàbääl nde Ɛlɔdyas, un'kyay a un'tɔŋ ande, anà ntɔn nde kàkyer ube asin bà ifà ifà,
nde kàfàkwɛy ube asin musà Ywan u bɔlokà.
Ndüümà a Yɛsu
Yàmɛnà naa baar banswà bàkyeenà mukàwal ndüümà. Yɛsu sye kàkàwal ndüümà. Mpal kàkäl nde muyamà, du waa làdubà,
Dweelà In'kyɛɛl kàyi udu ande kà imbuur imbuur asànaa yem. Ndaa yan'fà du yan'tɛn naa: « Ngye, ngye awà Mwan in'kwen mɛ, mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ wanswà we amu ngye. »
